technique_name: Explain the economic cost of the current situation.
description: The economic cost of the COVID-19 pandemic has been immense. Global GDP is estimated to decrease by $3.9 trillion this year as a result of coronavirus-induced measures. Additionally, the total number of unemployed persons worldwide is expected to surpass 195 million in 2020; this is 20 million more than in 2019.
